audit_items.proof_trace: `setLegionAddress` applies only an `onlyOwner` modifier and performs no zero-address validation on `updatedAddress` before writing to the mapping. Downstream consumers (`_syncLegionAddresses` in LegionAbstractSale, LegionPreLiquidApprovedSale, LegionCapitalRaise, etc.) cache the returned value directly without any zero-address check, so a zero address would silently propagate to critical roles (signer, fee receiver, vesting factory).
audit_items.attack_scenario: Owner (or compromised owner key) calls `setLegionAddress(LEGION_SIGNER_ID, address(0))`; subsequent calls to `_syncLegionAddresses` cache `address(0)` as the signer, permanently breaking signature-gated operations (investments, distributions) across all dependent contracts.
